notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 31 part 1 (Internet Archive buildingengineer3131cont), the 26 weekly issues from 3 January to 27 June 1931. Same method as the earlier volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1930-1933, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1931. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; 83 of the 122 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost or name that could not be read on the image was left out. Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor or architect named is the owner or shares the owner's surname that name is cut too. Sub-trade contracts are timeline entries and set no builder credit. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates come from the running heads (redate.py); the issue of 30 May, whose heads did not read, was dated from its cover (leaves 716 to 751). A permit for a row of houses is published only where the page says which lot it is; 35 such permits, most of them by owner-builders in the Sunset, were held.

coverage.remaining: Vols. 26 to 30 and vol. 31 part 1 read (January 1926 to June 1931); the other 23 half-year volumes (1915 to January 1932) are unread, vol. 31 part 2 (July 1931-January 1932, buildingengineer31232cont) next. In this volume: 218 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, all single houses with no architect named and no page, are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 231 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 462 rows were not placed: 214 location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), 88 street pairs that do not cross under the names read (OCR spellings, renamed streets) and 160 printed street numbers with no EAS row today.
coverage.note: 1,610 numbered entries read, 1,033 San Francisco rows, 571 placed on a parcel, 122 picked and read against the page image, 83 published on 79 pages (34 seeded), 39 held back: 35 permits for a row of two to eight houses placed on one lot only, one same-issue contract merged into the permit entry, and three uses or unit counts that contradict the roll.
